review.gallery: Nine Downtown tower renders from Binghatti’s branded project page, including a full skyline elevation and named interior examples.
review.location: The official two-page map provides a pin link on page 2 and six paired travel time and distance figures on page 1. The pin resolves to the named Downtown building. The two pages use different route estimates.
review.floorPlans: Seventeen official plan sheets show the six single-level unit layouts, both duplex and all three triplex levels, their overall area summaries and four typical floor arrangements. The level totals match the respective whole-residence imperial figures.

unavailable: A confirmed final entrance location and public retail floor plan were not established. Listing areas and drawing areas may apply to different units.
